newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian March manufacturing input prices fall.
newsitem.headline: Australian March manufacturing input prices fall.

text.p: Australian manufacturing input prices fell 1.5 percent in March from the previous month and were 3.3 percent lower than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
"Continuing price falls for locally-produced crude oil were the main contributors to the fall in the index," the bureau said.
This was partly offset by increased prices for metal ores.
The index for imported materials fell 1.8 percent in the month and 7.0 percent annually, while domestic materials fell 1.2 percent and 1.0 percent.
